keywords: Rei vindicatio – Declaration of title and ejectment – Plaintiff possessing undisputed paper title – Defendant claiming prescription to half share – Entry as caretaker/agent with leave and licence – Prescription does not run until adverse possession is clearly manifested to owner – Alleged oral promise by predecessor to transfer half share – Unilateral division of owner’s land ineffective – Claim for compensation for house and improvements – Improver with knowledge/no lawful basis not entitled to compensation – District Court judgment affirmed – Appeal dismissed.
legistation: Prescription Ordinance; Prevention of Frauds Ordinance principles concerning alleged promise relating to immovable property; Roman-Dutch law principles of rei vindicatio, agency/permissive possession and compensation for improvements.
